methodologyNotes: Covers standalone LED red light / near-infrared photobiomodulation panels intended for at-home whole-body or targeted use, sold at a published US price. Excludes wraps, pads, masks, handheld wands, and full-body beds/saunas. Price is US MSRP/typical retail in USD. wavelengthsNm lists the emitted peak wavelengths in nanometers, comma-separated as published (e.g. "660, 850"). irradianceMwCm2 is manufacturer-stated irradiance in mW/cm2 measured at 6 inches (15 cm) from the panel face; null if not disclosed at a stated distance. ledCount is the total number of LED diodes. totalPowerDrawWatts is rated wall power draw in watts (not summed diode wattage). treatmentAreaSqIn is the light-emitting surface area in square inches. beamAngleDeg is the LED lens beam angle in degrees. fdaClearance is an enum: "class-ii" (FDA-cleared Class II device), "registered" (FDA-registered only), or "none". appControl is a boolean for Bluetooth/Wi-Fi app session control. pulsingMode is a boolean for a pulsed/frequency treatment mode. panelDimensionsIn is outer height x width x depth in inches. weightLbs is device weight in pounds.
